''Aug. li. 5 de bapt. c. 10''.}}∷ vnto remi{{ls}}sion of {{ls}}innes. {{verse|chapter=1|verse=5}} And there vvent forth to him al the countrie of Ievvrie, and al they of Hieru{{ls}}alem: and vvere baptized of him in the riuer of Iordan, {{sup|‖}} confe{{ls}}sing {{sup|‖}} their {{ls}}innes. {{verse|chapter=1|verse=6}} And Iohn vvas {{sup|‖}} clothed vvith camels heare, and a girdle of a {{ls}}kinne about his loines: and he did eate locu{{ls}}tes and vvild honie. {{verse|chapter=1|verse=7}} And he preached, {{ls}}aying, There commeth a {{ls}}tronger then I after me: vvho{{ls}}e latchet of his {{ls}}hoes I am not vvorthie {{ls}}touping dovvne to vnloo{{ls}}e. {{verse|chapter=1|verse=8}} I haue baptized you {{sup|‖}} vvith vvater: but he {{ls}}hal baptize you vvith the holy Gho{{ls}}t.
